candidates.name: West Texas Express Pipeline
candidates.from: Waha hub area, Permian Basin, TX
candidates.to: El Paso area, TX (laterals to Hudspeth County and US-Mexico border)

evidence.note: Enbridge non-binding open season 10-25 Sep 2026; greenfield intrastate line, more than 150 miles of new 42-inch pipe, up to 2 Bcf/d, target in service Q4 2029
same open season announcement, more than 150 miles of 42-inch OD pipe

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row names it. Closest are P7840 Transwestern Desert Southwest Expansion (different sponsor, 516 km to Arizona) and P0268 Trans-Pecos; neither is this line. Length over 150 mi (about 240 km).

candidates.name: Solitude Pipeline System
candidates.sponsor: WhiteWater (50%), Devon, MPLX, Diamondback, Western Midstream

evidence.note: FID on two 48-inch lines Permian to Katy, 2.25 Bcf/d late 2029 plus 2.25 Bcf/d in 2030
Devon announcement of FID on Solitude, in service second half 2029

candidates.from: new Delaware Basin processing plants (Wrangler, Ranger, Ranger II)
